name: RoboMaster Referee System Speed Monitor Module SM01 (17 mm)

files.note: Single multi-body part, 32 bodies. bbox length includes the cables/aviation connectors; cross-section 43.4 x 42.4 vs official 43.5 x 38.9 (check which feature sets the 42.4).

colors: Black housing with RoboMaster 'R' logo near the muzzle end; LED dot-matrix strip (120 LEDs) behind a translucent window along both sides that lights when a projectile passes; black cables to two aviation connectors (silver rings).
notes: Specs: 12 V, 17 W max, 1-50 m/s, 1-35 Hz. Current module per 2026 user manual (SM01 = 17 mm, SM11 = 42 mm).
